title: Flight Information Schema
description: Authoritative schema for PyNeats flight data

FlightInformationType.description: Top-level flight envelope containing identification, airports, aircraft, fuel, and trajectory.

confidential.description: Whether the flight data is confidential ('true' / 'false').

departure_date_time.description: Departure time in ISO-8601 format, as supplied (the AO upload schema gives the flight-plan EOBT). Copied verbatim to the output field aobt; not parsed.

arrival_date_time.description: Arrival time in ISO-8601 format, as supplied. Not used by PyNeats.

departure_airport.description: ICAO code of the departure airport, e.g. 'EHAM'.

arrival_airport.description: ICAO code of the arrival airport, e.g. 'ENZV'.

engine_uid.description: Engine UID from the ICAO Aircraft Engine Emissions Databank (EDB), e.g. '3CM026'; not an engine name.

load_factor.description: Payload mass / maximum payload mass (BADA MPL, or MTOW - OEW when BADA gives no positive MPL), dimensionless, 0 to 1; not a seat load factor. PyNEATS sets a value above 1 to 1.0 (with a warning) and rejects a negative value.

takeoff_mass.description: Take-off mass in kg: the mass at the start of the take-off run. PyNEATS fails the flight when the value is below the BADA OEW or above 1.05 x the BADA MTOW of the aircraft type.

FuelPropertiesType.description: Fuel composition properties. All fields are optional and nullable.

hydrogen_content.description: Hydrogen content of the fuel in wt.% (percent by mass, e.g. 13.79), not a 0-1 fraction.

aromatic_content.description: Aromatics content of the fuel, % by volume basis (MRR Annex IIIa 5(4)); percent or fraction scale not defined. Not used in PyNeats calculations.

calorific_value.description: Lower calorific value in J/kg (the AO gives MJ/kg; the NEATS application multiplies by 1e6). A value outside 35e6-50e6 J/kg makes the flight fail.

naphthalene.description: Naphthalene content of the fuel, % by volume basis (MRR Annex IIIa 5(4)); percent or fraction scale not defined. Not used in PyNeats calculations.

sulphur.description: Sulphur content of the fuel, % by mass basis (MRR Annex IIIa 5(4)); percent or fraction scale not defined. Not used in PyNeats calculations.

TrajectoryType.description: Trajectory envelope containing data source and waypoint array.

fl.description: Flight level: ISA pressure altitude in hundreds of feet, e.g. 350 for FL350. Always read as a flight level and converted to metres as FL x 30.48 m; never read as an altitude in feet or metres.

ff.description: Fuel flow in kg/s for the whole aircraft (all engines), not per engine.

ee.description: Overall propulsion efficiency (thrust x true airspeed / (fuel flow x lower calorific value)), dimensionless fraction.

tas.description: True airspeed in m/s (the AO gives knots; the NEATS application converts to m/s before calling PyNeats).
